sections.title: Raw source
items: Summary: Player resource gained from Hope results and spent to help or use features.
When: Use when players want to support a roll, use an Experience, Tag Team, or trigger a feature.
Not When: Do not spend it for undefined bonuses outside supported moves.
Question: What can I do with Hope?
Answer: Help, use an Experience, Tag Team, or use a Hope Feature.
Example: Marlowe spends Hope to apply Royal Mage to a ward-reading roll.
Aliases: with Hope hope spend spend Hope
Source: Official SRD / local quickstart reference. Use private full-rulebook material only at the table.
